competency.title: Compare speech perception — simulated task
competency.outcome: Compare two plausible methods for speech perception using a speech-to-intent transcript. Use a seeded simulation with an explicit environment version.

topic_kernel.measure: word error and intent accuracy by noise level

competency.practice_task: Produce a paired comparison and tradeoff table grounded in a speech-to-intent transcript.
competency.setting_constraint: Use a seeded simulation with an explicit environment version.
required_evidence: a paired comparison and tradeoff table
Include the simulator config, seed band and baseline run.
Report word error and intent accuracy by noise level with uncertainty or an explicit deterministic check.
Construct a negative control for the failure mode: inventing speech in silence.

assessment.scoring: Each criterion: 0 absent, 1 partial, 2 demonstrated; require 2 on all four.
assessment.threshold_policy: Register the metric threshold, baseline, task budget and evaluator before exposing new items.
criteria: Concept: correctly state the assumptions and limits of speech perception.
Practice: same inputs and budgets yield a justified choice.
Measurement: report word error and intent accuracy by noise level against a matched baseline with reproducible inputs.
Critical check: test for inventing speech in silence; detect it or rule it out with evidence.

competency.source_policy: Reviewer must add a verified primary source before lesson status; no source is fabricated here.
competency.contamination_policy: No private items, answers, seeds or reviewer-only prompts in this public specification.
